title: dataDir
description: The product's data folder in its git repo (`data` unless lathe.config.json names another): one JSONL file per table, versioned by git with the rest of the repo. A write changes its files all or nothing: it writes each changed file's new text into the folder's .lathe-write/ (which ignores itself in git), then a journal of the files to put in place and remove, then renames each into place and deletes the folder; the next load after a crash finishes a write whose journal is there and rolls back one whose journal is not, and says which. Lathe's own rows, such as its built-in checks, load beside it read-only from the package's data folder (`LATHE_DATA_DIR`). The store loads every file into DuckDB in memory on each load.

title: lathe.config.json
description: The product repo's config file in its root folder, written by `lathe init` and by hand, versioned by git: the schema version its data is for and where its data folder is.

title: userData
description: The desktop shell's user data folder (Electron's `app.getPath('userData')`), outside any repo: small JSON files the shell reads as it starts and rewrites whole through a temporary file (`writeJson`), such as window-state.json and recent-folders.json.

title: ~/.claude/projects
description: Claude Code's folder of session transcripts, one JSONL file per session under the project's folder, which Claude Code writes and the desktop app only reads.

title: skillFolders
description: The folders Claude Code keeps skills and slash commands in: the product folder's .claude, the Owner's ~/.claude, the installed plugins' and the Lathe plugin's, which Claude Code and the plugins write and the desktop app only reads.

title: localStorage
description: The browser's local storage for the app's origin: kept in this browser from one launch to the next, cleared with the browser's data; the app works on without it.

title: sessionStorage
description: The browser's session storage for the app's origin, one per browser tab or desktop window: kept while it stays open, gone when it closes.

title: memory
description: Each process's own memory: the engine's DuckDB database and read model tables, the app's indexes and views, and the desktop shell's map of open windows. Kept only while the process runs, and rebuilt from the data files and saved state on each start.
